spec.name: Orange Kitchen Coffee Machine
spec.description: Retro orange espresso machine on a full-block kitchen cabinet, with brushed steel fascia, twin group heads, brass controls, a text-free pressure gauge, recessed drip tray and ivory espresso cup. Front faces -Z; cabinet rests at y0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Coffee Machine. Retro espresso machine atop kitchen cabinet, brushed metal front, twin group heads, brass controls, pressure gauge without text, drip tray and small ceramic cup. Main cabinet collision footprint x0..16,y0..16,z0..16, front -Z. Cooktop props may extend to y25.
